changelog: Added automatic GitHub main-branch (version.json) update checking on app launch using PackageInfoCompat, an accessible Update Available dialog showing version and changelog with Update Now & Later actions, direct in-app APK download with live progress, FileProvider package installer integration, and Android 8+ Install Unknown Apps permission guidance.
